timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Synchronicity of love and love is everywhere.
So worry less, trust more, find your inner confidence.
The inner confidence that gives you selfless confidence,
selfless confidence.
So keep your eyes and your ears open to the opportunities that are constantly in motion all around us.
Outside of these walls, I say you can take the ideas of quantum physics and apply them to the everyday world.
And outside of these walls you can't describe what's going on other than a superposition, a combination of possibilities.
They're not yet determined.
And so when you go out these doors tonight, catch yourself making assumptions about what's going to happen, about what's already happened.
And then open up.
I invite you to open up your mind to consider the possibilities that you didn't even realize were there.
I may look to you just like a guy out of UC Berkeley studying physics, eating granola, long hair hippy type physicists, living on telegraph avenue.
But the truth is I lived on hillogas avenue, a couple blocks away.
And when I was studying physics at UC Berkeley, I was my undergraduate.
My lab partner and best friend at the time, Jay would say, well, I would say, I wish my hand would cost him safe.
I want to understand why that happens. Why is it that way?
How many of you have asked that question? Why is it that way?
And my friend would say, man, we can't ask why.
Physics is only about how.
And I disagree. And I still disagree.
Because what physics is, if it's anything, is it's pointing to a whole description of life.
A whole description, including my own life and your life and what we experience in the world.
And in that description, there has to be love. There has to be love.
So physics has to describe love if it's to be physics at all.
I want to create this idea in the world. I want it to grow. And I invite you to join me.
I am leading an online class. I just invite you to join me there.
Because we need to, I think, build this understanding and this idea in the world.
Because it can take us to another level. Loving each other and believing in ourselves, selfless confidence.
To do not just good in the world, but our good. What good we have to offer specifically.
That's what selfless confidence is to me.
Thank you.
